full_prompt_en: A square impressionist oil landscape shows a narrow pale path following a blue pond toward a white farmhouse in an autumn valley. The upper portion opens into distant purple and blue hills beneath a clear pale sky, while the nearer slopes are patched with gold, muted green, rose, and rust. Near the center of the far bank, the small farmhouse catches the sun; its bright wall and dark window openings stand out against an orange-gold tree above it. A low white fence stretches from the house across the slope. Tall dark trunks at the left and right edges frame the view, their foliage forming broken masses of ochre and deep blue-green. Across the lower left, the pond is saturated cobalt and indigo, reflecting bright bits of sky and nearby foliage in uneven patches. The near shore is dark and thick with vegetation, while the light path enters at the lower right and bends toward the middle distance. Its gently curving edge separates cool shadow from the warm fields beyond. Short, visible oil strokes and small touches of contrasting color build both solid trees and open ground. The brushwork is loose enough to shimmer, yet the main path, house, and banks remain easy to read. Sunlight falls from the upper left across the distant house and yellow fields, leaving the foreground pool and wooded banks in cooler shade. The overall composition draws the eye from a deep blue foreground through a pale winding path toward a small sunlit center, balancing warm autumn foliage with cool water and shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形印象派油画风景，一条窄浅色小路沿着蓝色池塘通向秋日山谷中的白色农舍。画面上部在清淡天空下展开远处紫蓝色山丘，近处坡地则拼接金黄、低调绿色、玫瑰色和锈红。远岸中央附近，小农舍沐浴阳光；明亮墙面和深色窗洞在上方一棵橙金色树木前格外突出。一道低矮白篱笆从房屋沿山坡伸展。左右边缘的高大深色树干框住视野，枝叶形成断续的赭色和深蓝绿色团块。左下方，池塘呈饱和的钴蓝与靛蓝，天空和附近枝叶的亮色碎片在其中不均匀地反射。近岸植被深暗厚实，浅色小路则从右下进入，弯向中远景。它轻轻弯曲的边缘将冷调阴影与远处暖色田地分开。短而可见的油彩笔触与小片对比色同时构筑坚实树木和开阔地面。笔法足够松动，形成闪烁感，但主要道路、房屋和岸边仍容易辨认。日光从左上方照向远处房屋与黄色田地，让前景池水和林岸保留在更冷的阴影中。整体构图引导视线由深蓝前景沿浅色弯路抵达小小的阳光中心，在暖秋枝叶与冷水、阴影之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: This is a luminous oil-painted treatment made from short, broken strokes and neighboring dabs of contrasting pigment. Gold, rust, rose, and olive passages play against cobalt, indigo, violet, and deep blue-green shadows. Forms remain readable through large value patterns, while their edges flicker with exposed brush marks instead of closing into hard outlines. A light winding passage can lead across darker masses toward a concentrated warm focal area. Reflections and foliage share a fragmented, shimmering texture, with small color notes accumulating into broader surfaces when viewed from a distance. Directional daylight lights selected planes while the foreground stays richly cool, giving the picture depth without smooth photographic modeling. The effect is intimate, vibrant, and airy despite the thickly worked paint.
style_prompt_zh: 这是一种明亮的油画处理，由短促断续笔触与相邻的对比颜料点构成。金色、锈红、玫瑰色和橄榄色区域与钴蓝、靛蓝、紫色及深蓝绿色阴影相互作用。形体通过大块明度关系保持可读，边缘却随外露笔痕闪动，而不是闭合成硬轮廓。浅色弯曲通道可以穿越深色团块，引向集中而温暖的焦点。反光与细密表面共享破碎闪烁的肌理，许多小色点在远看时汇成宽阔表面。定向日光照亮选定平面，前景则保持浓郁冷色，使画面在没有平滑摄影式塑形的情况下获得纵深。效果亲密、鲜活，厚实的颜料之中仍有通透空气感。
theme_en: An autumn path beside a blue pond leading toward a white farmhouse
theme_zh: 蓝色池塘边通往白色农舍的秋日小径
name: Daniel Garber
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
